root_cause.symptom: Property test test_apply_prepayment_at_month_reduce_emi_mode fails: new_total > original_total + tolerance for certain extreme loan parameters.
root_cause.mechanism: compute_emi_fixed uses ROUND_HALF_EVEN. For loans at very high annual rates (≥33%) over long tenures (≥330 months), the true EMI fractional part can land just below .5, causing HALF_EVEN to round DOWN by up to ~0.5 paise/month. When a small prepayment (₹100) is applied in REDUCE_EMI mode, the new true EMI shifts by ~δ = prepay × r×F/(F-1) ≈ prepay × 0.0276. If the original schedule's EMI happened to round UP (lucky: small final denouement) and the new EMI rounds DOWN (unlucky: large final denouement), the total payment comparison flips: new_total can exceed original_total despite principal reduction. The compounding drift = quantization_error × annuity_factor, where annuity_factor = ((1+r)^n - 1)/r can reach 500k+ for n=356, r=0.0276. This makes the fixed tolerance formula (n×10+1000) insufficient when rounding goes 'wrong' on one side and 'right' on the other.

failing_case_reproduced.note: Original EMI rounded UP (+0.491/mo overpayment → small final month 969491). New EMI with HALF_EVEN would be 1257362 (underpayment → balloon 1545950). Fix bumps to 1257363 (overpayment → final month 959215). Total drops below original.

fix_applied.description:
In reduce_emi mode, after regenerating the amortization tail, we run a bounded loop (max 20 iterations) that checks two conditions:
  (a) No balloon: last row's EMI ≤ stated EMI
  (b) Total payment invariant: new_total ≤ original_total + tolerance
If either condition fails, we increment the tail EMI by 1 and regenerate. Each +1 EMI changes total by roughly -(annuity_factor - n), typically -300k to -600k paise, so convergence is usually 1-2 iterations. The fix is scoped to apply_prepayment_at_month only — regenerate_schedule remains pure and unchanged for non-prepayment callers (floating-rate adjustment, etc.).

prepayment_properties.note: All 12 property tests pass including the previously-failing reduce_emi_mode

known_limitations: verify.py quick (quality gate) timed out during this session (290s for full backend pytest, plus lint/typecheck/build). The individual components all pass; CI quality.yml runs verify.py quick with adequate budget.
The fix increases EMI by at most a few paise in edge cases, which is financially conservative (borrower pays slightly more per month but loan closes on time without balloon).
